cards.title: Tidepool Timekeeper Shell-Clock Clues
cards.showSkill: turn readiness into visible tidepool clues
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card show-not-tell card for changing one plain tidepool sentence into shell-clock clues a reader can picture: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place one pretend index card beside the tidepool prompt and invite small paper details, keeping the whole scene invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Start with the plain line, then show the timekeeper's moment through clues instead of naming the feeling: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The tidepool timekeeper was ready. Copy or change the plain sentence before adding clues: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Show readiness with one shell mark, bead dial, tide strip, or tiny flag the reader can see: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the shell clock, bead dial, or paper flag do one small thing that proves the moment has started: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one tidepool shelf, pool rim, note tray, or jar line that signals the lab is set for the next step: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the timekeeper's readiness with one hand, chin, pencil, or shoulder movement: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Paper-safe sound or texture: Add a soft click, shell scrape, ripple mark, smooth shell, or gritty card edge: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of naming readiness, write: The tidepool timekeeper ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Remove one feeling word and replace it with one visible shell-clock clue: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle one tidepool clue and write the revised show sentence on the card: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Use a fresh index card to show a tidepool helper being ready without naming the feeling: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Draft Wake
cards.showSkill: replace a feeling claim with revision evidence
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card show-not-tell card for turning a plain ferry draft sentence into visible revision evidence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out one pretend ferry draft card and ask for clues that show the helper thinking through a change: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Change the plain ferry line by adding what the helper sees, adjusts, touches, or compares on paper: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The ferry helper was confused. Copy or change the plain sentence before showing the confusion: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Show confusion with one crossed-out draft word, tilted sign, ripple arrow, or mismatched ferry tag: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the draft card, folded oar token, rope tag, or ferry note shift, tap, slide, or point: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one dock card, deck plank mark, river margin, or signpost clue that shows where the draft problem appears: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the helper's confusion with one brow, finger, pause, or pencil movement: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Paper-safe sound or texture: Add a pencil scratch, soft paper flap, rope rub, ripple line, or damp-looking card edge: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of naming confusion, write: The ferry helper ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Trade the feeling word for two ferry clues, one from an object and one from the helper: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Underline the plain word and write one ferry clue that shows it without saying it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Try one more ferry sentence where the draft change is shown through a paper clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Pointer Glow
cards.showSkill: show curiosity through labels and display clues
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card show-not-tell card for turning a plain tower sentence into clue labels, display signals, and gesture evidence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the card beside a made-up tower label and invite one clue trail that stays fictional and paper-only: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Show what makes the clue keeper curious by using labels, objects, and gestures instead of naming curiosity: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The clue keeper was curious. Copy or change the plain sentence before building visible evidence: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Show curiosity with one crooked label, bright pointer strip, tiny question mark, or lifted display tag: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the label card, pointer strip, display tag, or clue drawer move, tilt, unfold, or reveal: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one tower shelf, display step, glassy case, or label rail clue that pulls attention to the mystery: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the keeper's curiosity with one lean, squint, careful reach, or pencil hover: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Paper-safe sound or texture: Add a paper whisper, label peel, smooth case shine, dusty edge, or crisp card bend: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of naming curiosity, write: The clue keeper ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Replace the feeling word with one label clue and one keeper gesture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Draw a tiny label box, then write the clue that shows the keeper wants to know more: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Create another tower sentence where a label shows curiosity before the character says anything: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Steady Needle
cards.showSkill: show careful choice through object action
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card show-not-tell card for changing a plain compass sentence into careful object action and place signals: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place two invented compass-craft options beside the card and ask for clues that show careful choosing: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Show the crafter being careful by naming what the paper compass does and how the character checks it: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The compass crafter was careful. Copy or change the plain sentence before showing the care: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Show careful work with one aligned arrow, centered bead, tiny fold mark, or neat pencil tick: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the paper needle, bead marker, folded arrow, or compass card swivel, settle, pause, or line up: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one craft bench, supply tray, marker rail, or folded-paper stand that shows where the careful choice happens: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the crafter's care with one slow breath, narrowed eyes, steady hand, or second check: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Paper-safe sound or texture: Add a soft paper creak, bead tap, smooth fold, pencil tick, or crisp card corner: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of naming care, write: The compass crafter ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Replace the plain adjective with one compass action and one small checking gesture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Mark the careful object action first, then write the revised sentence below it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Invent another compass-craft sentence where careful choice appears through a tool clue: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Boardwalk Clasp Promise
cards.showSkill: show pride through a promise and page detail
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable index card show-not-tell card for turning a plain boardwalk sentence into page clues, gesture, and texture detail: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place a pretend folded-page card beside this prompt and keep the promise small, kind, and fully invented: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Show the page helper's pride through a careful object detail and a gentle action, without naming the feeling: ____________________.
cards.plainLinePrompt: Plain line: The page helper felt proud. Copy or change the plain sentence before showing pride through details: ____________________.
cards.visibleCluePrompt: Visible clue: Show pride with one straightened clasp, neat thread loop, polished page edge, or tucked promise slip: ____________________.
cards.objectActionPrompt: Object action: Make the booklet clasp, folded page, thread loop, or sign card close, shine, settle, or line up: ____________________.
cards.placeSignalPrompt: Place signal: Add one boardwalk rail, booklet stand, paper booth, or page table clue that shows the promise has been kept: ____________________.
cards.characterGesturePrompt: Character gesture: Show the helper's pride with one small nod, careful smile, lifted chin, or gentle pat on the page: ____________________.
cards.soundOrTexturePrompt: Paper-safe sound or texture: Add a clasp click, thread brush, smooth page edge, crisp fold, or soft card tap: ____________________.
cards.sentenceFramePrompt: Sentence frame: Instead of naming pride, write: The page helper ____________________.
cards.reviseShowPrompt: Revise show: Replace the feeling word with one kept-promise clue and one page-helper gesture: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Choose one clasp or page clue, then write a sentence that shows pride silently: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Carry-on line: Make one more boardwalk index card where a page detail shows a gentle promise kept: ____________________.
